SELECT title, date FROM govblock_oversight.oversight_reports WHERE source = 'CRS' AND lower(title) LIKE '%student loan%' ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 10
Which federal departments funded the research behind the most published patent applications?
SELECT level_one AS department, count(DISTINCT pgpub_id) AS applications FROM govblock_patents.pv_pg_gov_interest_org GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How large was the federal debt at the end of fiscal 2000?
SELECT try_cast(debt_outstanding_amt AS double) AS debt FROM govblock_treasury.debt_outstanding WHERE record_date = '2000-09-30'
Which New York load zones used the most power on average in 2023?

SELECT name, avg(try_cast(integrated_load AS double)) AS average_mw FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_zonal_load_hourly_palintegrated WHERE substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) = '2023' AND name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Who ran for the U.S. Senate in Pennsylvania in 2024?
SELECT DISTINCT cand_name, cand_pty_affiliation FROM govblock_fec.candidates WHERE cand_office = 'S' AND cand_office_st = 'PA' AND cast(cand_election_yr AS varchar) = '2024'
Which categories of federal award are most numerous: contracts, grants, loans or direct payments?
SELECT category, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_award_search WHERE category IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How has the number of NIH projects changed from 2015 to 2024?
SELECT fy, count(*) AS projects FROM govblock_grants.nih_projects WHERE try_cast(fy AS integer) BETWEEN 2015 AND 2024 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which government agencies have the most forms in the collection?
SELECT agency, count(*) AS forms FROM govblock_reference.forms GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the average commercial electricity rate across U.S. ZIP codes?
SELECT avg(try_cast(comm_rate AS double)) AS average FROM govblock_solar.urdb_zip_rates
Which dosage forms are most common among approved drug products?
SELECT dosage_form, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_products WHERE dosage_form IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many bioassays does PubChem hold?
Which parent companies offer the most Medicare Advantage plans in Texas?
Ma Enrollment By Contract Plan State County

SELECT parent_organization, count(DISTINCT concat(contract_id, '-', plan_id)) AS plans FROM govblock_health.ma_enrollment_by_contract_plan_state_county WHERE state = 'TX' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the highest real-time price for 10-minute spinning reserves in eastern New York in 2022?
Nyiso As Prices Real Time 5 Min Rtasp
SELECT max(try_cast(east_10_min_spinning_reserve_mwhr AS double)) AS highest FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_as_prices_real_time_5_min_rtasp WHERE substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) = '2022'
Which fuels power the most units in EPA's Clean Air Markets programs in 2023?
SELECT primary_fuel_type, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.campd_facility_attributes WHERE year = 2023 AND primary_fuel_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much did utility-scale solar generation grow from 2015 to 2024?
SELECT period, try_cast(value AS double) AS thousand_mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_elec_data WHERE series_id = 'ELEC.GEN.SUN-US-99.A' AND period IN ('2015', '2024') ORDER BY 1
Which categories of drinking water violation are most common?

SELECT CASE violation_category_code WHEN 'MCL' THEN 'Maximum contaminant level' WHEN 'MR' THEN 'Monitoring and reporting' WHEN 'MON' THEN 'Monitoring' WHEN 'RPT' THEN 'Reporting' WHEN 'TT' THEN 'Treatment technique' WHEN 'MRDL' THEN 'Maximum residual disinfectant level' ELSE violation_category_code END AS category, count(DISTINCT violation_id) AS violations FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_violations_enforcement GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What were total reported greenhouse gas emissions, in tons of carbon dioxide equivalent, in 2022?
SELECT sum(try_cast(co2e_emission AS double)) AS co2e FROM govblock_environment.ghg_facts_subp_ghg_emission WHERE year = '2022'
Which databases contribute the most compound records to UniChem?

SELECT s.name_long, count(*) AS records FROM govblock_chemistry.unichem_reference AS r JOIN govblock_chemistry.unichem_source AS s ON cast(s.src_id AS varchar) = cast(r.src_id AS varchar) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of drinking water violations are classed as major?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN is_major_viol_ind = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_violations_enforcement WHERE is_major_viol_ind IS NOT NULL
Which utilities have the most rate schedules in the Utility Rate Database?
SELECT utility, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_siting.utility_rate_database WHERE utility IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many ChEMBL activity results reach a pChEMBL value of 9 or more?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_activities WHERE pchembl_value >= 9
Which foreign patent offices do U.S. applications most often claim priority from?
SELECT parent_country, count(*) AS claims FROM govblock_patents.patex_foreign_priority_25 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How are hazardous waste generators split between large, small and very small quantity?
SELECT hreport_universe_record, count(*) AS facilities FROM govblock_environment.echo_rcra_facilities GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
